beats.title: Space-to-ground
beats.text: Houston Audio Control Room, STS-135. Atlantis leaves the station for the last time. Press play on the comms panel. The recording does not start by itself.

beats.title: JEM Pressurized Module
beats.text: Kibo, the JEM Pressurized Module. Japan’s big lab. Saibo and Ryutai are inside. ELM-PS, the storage attic, sits on the zenith.

beats.title: JEM airlock to JEM-EF
beats.text: The JEM airlock passes a payload onto the Exposed Facility. JEMRMS is the Japanese arm. MAXI and CALET sit on the porch, outside in vacuum.

beats.title: IDA-2
beats.text: IDA-2, Harmony’s forward port, NASA Docking System. The ship flies itself in. The docking gallery has probe-and-drogue, CBM berthing, and who transfers propellant.
